meta.source: team 24089 (Iron Lions) proj_motion.py — an OFFLINE pygame projectile-motion model of the DECODE artifact
meta.purpose: Physics/ballistics constants feeding a deterministic trajectory + launch-angle solver (§9). Extracted per Phase-1: constants -> structured data, NOT reproduced as a code pattern.

corrections.why: Standard gravity is ~386.4 in/s^2 (32.2 ft/s^2 x 12; precise 386.088 = 9.80665 m/s^2). Corrected AT SOURCE per Phase-1 — the solver (scripts/trajectory_solver.py) consumes THIS value, not 385.

caveats_from_source: 24089's own launch-angle solver (proj_motion.py:39) is broken WIP: `1/math.atan((-d + math.sqrt(d**2 - 768*(d)/()))/())` — reciprocal-of-atan + division-by-empty-tuple (a real syntax/runtime error). NOT reproduced; replaced by a correct closed-form solver in trajectory_solver.py.
Ball modeled as a HOLLOW 5-inch ball with drag reduced for holes (Cd=0.3, effective area x0.7). These are 24089's modeling choices, carried as-is (their values, not independently verified).
